feature_name: Fix TypeScript overload resolution for infiniteQueryOptions
description: Update the TypeScript definitions for infiniteQueryOptions to properly resolve method overloads when getNextPageParam is not provided. Currently, TypeScript incorrectly selects an overload that allows skipToken compatibility, causing type errors when getNextPageParam is missing. This fix should ensure the correct overload is selected and that getNextPageParam is properly required.
functional_requirements: Remove the optional designation from the second parameter in the infiniteQueryOptions TypeScript overloads
Ensure getNextPageParam remains a required parameter for infiniteQueryOptions
Add TypeScript tests to verify the fix prevents the skipToken type error when getNextPageParam is missing
Maintain compatibility with existing useInfiniteQuery patterns while fixing the overload resolution
